subject: MAP drift: recovery checklist and escalation path
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Susan Park <susan.park@summitanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Stalled milestone — MAP update and proposed recovery steps

Hi Susan,

Quick note on the MAP and the close timeline: we're seeing the July 31st go-live milestone drifting due to two blockers you flagged — procurement PO timing and the outstanding security questionnaire review. Root cause appears to be procurement needing an internal vendor onboarding packet and a final sign-off from InfoSec that we've been iterating on.

Suggested recovery checklist (short term):
- Target a compressed procurement approval window: 72 hours from PO submission.
- Agree to complete the remaining security Qs by EOD Tuesday (we'll provide a response matrix).
- Run a short POC on hosted inference (no infra setup) so product evaluation can proceed while procurement finishes.

Can you confirm if procurement can commit to a 72-hour turnaround once we hand over the vendor packet? If not, please propose a specific date we should re-baseline to so we can update the MAP and commitments.

I can circulate a one-page vendor packet and a filled security worksheet by EOD today.

Thanks,
Aditya
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

[Attachment: MAP_rebaseline_v2.xlsx (xlsx) — draft rebaseline with compressed milestones]

From: Susan Park <susan.park@summitanalytics.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@summitanalytics.com
Date: 2025-07-10T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Stalled milestone — MAP update and proposed recovery steps

Aditya,

Thanks for the clear summary. Short answers:
- Procurement can do 72 hours only if we tag this as high priority and provide the final vendor packet today. There is a backlog but escalation helps.
- InfoSec needs the security questionnaire answered and a short architecture diagram. They indicated they can review within 3 business days once they have everything.

We like the idea of a hosted POC in parallel; product team wants to keep evaluating while procurement finishes.

I'll ask procurement to respond with a targeted approval date once we submit the packet. Attaching the internal procurement checklist for your reference.

Susan
Product Lead, Summit Analytics

[Attachment: Summit_procurement_checklist.pdf (pdf)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Susan Park <susan.park@summitanalytics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-11T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Stalled milestone — MAP update and proposed recovery steps

Looping in a proposed mitigation plan and the exact wording we recommend for an executive procurement nudge.

Mitigation plan (immediate):
1) We will finalize and deliver the vendor onboarding packet + architecture diagram by 12:00pm PT today.
2) We will complete and attach security questionnaire answers (see attached pdf) for InfoSec review the same day.
3) Start hosted POC tomorrow morning with limited token budget — results to product by Thursday.
4) If procurement does not confirm a 72-hour window by EOD Wednesday, we propose re-baselining the go-live to 2025-08-14 and locking all downstream milestones accordingly.

Suggested executive nudge copy (to procurement exec):
"Hi [Procurement Exec],
We appreciate your team. This engagement is time-boxed — approving Redwood Inference as a vendor within 72 hours of receiving the completed packet enables Summit to begin product validation this week and keeps the project on the agreed Q3 timeline. Delays will force Summit to consider a two-week re-baseline that impacts integration and launch planning. Can you confirm escalation availability? — Marissa Cole, AE"

Attachments: MAP_rebaseline_v2.xlsx (with the 3 options: compressed, baseline, re-baseline) and security-questionnaire-answers.pdf.

Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

[Attachment: MAP_rebaseline_v2.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment: security-questionnaire-answers.pdf (pdf)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Susan Park <susan.park@summitanalytics.com>
Date: 2025-07-11T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Stalled milestone — MAP update and proposed recovery steps

Laura — forwarding the thread. Quick summary for an exec nudge: procurement backlog + one final InfoSec Q is the gating item. Product is ready to proceed with hosted POC to keep evaluation momentum. If procurement cannot do 72 hours after packet submission, we should re-baseline to Aug 14 and update the MAP; we also risk losing preferred Q3 launch slots.

Could you send a short note to the procurement lead and their manager (suggested copy below) and loop in our Partnerships lead if needed? The HubSpot record is HS-12345.

Suggested copy (short):
"Hi [Procurement Lead],
We want to highlight the business impact of a fast vendor onboarding for Summit's Q3 delivery plan. Approving the Redwood vendor packet within 72 hours will allow the product team to continue evaluation and keep the charted go-live. If you prefer, we can run the initial validation on Redwood's hosted environment while procurement completes vendor onboarding. Please confirm escalation contacts for a 72-hour SLA. — Laura Bennett, Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference"

Happy to hop on a 15-minute call with you and Marissa before you send.

Aditya
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Susan Park <susan.park@summitanalytics.com>, procurement@summitanalytics.com
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-12T15:34:00-07:00
Subject: Executive note: vendor packet & 72-hour procurement SLA request

Susan / Procurement team —

Thanks for the context, Susan. Summit's product timeline is tightly coupled with a Q3 rollout window. Approving the vendor packet within 72 hours of receipt will materially reduce downstream risk to integration and marketing commitments. To be clear: without that SLA we will need to shift the MAP and target a new go-live of 2025-08-14. That re-baseline will impact integration and go-to-market timing.

We are ready to provide any supplementary materials and to run an initial evaluation on Redwood's hosted environment immediately so your product team can continue testing while procurement completes internal checks. Please confirm the internal escalation contact who can commit to a 72-hour turnaround once the packet is submitted.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
